records.deidentified_narrative: on the date and time listed above, police responded to the listed location for an accident major. the key card detailed that a motor vehicle struck a 5 year old pedestrian who was walking. i arrived at the location and made contact with p3, the mother of ped 1. p3 informed me that the incident occurred prior to the police call. p3 informed me that p2, p4, and herself were on foot walking west across the 1000 block of poteet jourdanton fwy when unit 1 struck p2 with her vehicle. p2 had no visible injuries and was interacting with other personnel. p2 was evaluated by ems at the scene. p3 requested for p2 to be transported by ems #[medical facility] for a further evaluation. i gathered p2, p3, and p4's information [medical facility] by ems #25. i interviewed unit 1 driver at the scene of the incident. unit 1 driver stated she was exiting the listed location turning north on the 1000 block of poteet jourdanton fwy. unit 1 driver stated that [roadway] to be clear of vehicles so she may safely turn. unit 1 driver stated that as she began to turn left, she saw p2 at [roadway] and struck him with her vehicle. p2 was struck on the front of unit 1 and did not go underneath unit 1. all parties involved did not appear to be under the influence or intoxicated at the time of the incident. i observed the scene where the incident occurred. i observed no skit marks or anything related to the incident. there was no cross walk where the incident occurred. unit 1 did not have any reported damage to her vehicle. i verified unit 1's information through my computer. i contacted tid detective valenzuela #2189 and informed him of the incident. valenzuela #2189 advised me to contact csi to photograph the incident scene and unit 1. patten #2557 was contacted to photograph the incident location and unit 1. i provided unit 1 driver with the [case id] of the incident. bwc dme and coban available.

records.deidentified_narrative: ""on december 14, 2020 at 5:55 pm, i, sgt. timothy leathers, was dispatched to 1550 n. central expressway (buc-ees) for major accident. dispatch advised it was vehicle vs pedestrian. upon arrival, i observed a group of people standing around a female who was lying on her side in the parking lot front of pump 17. the woman, amanda bell dob [date], was crying and saying it hurt. i asked where she was hurting at, she stated her left side. i advised dispatch of her injuries. while speaking with her i observed collin county deputy a. alejandro and j. duncan arrived on scene. i requested deputy a. alenjandro to get a vol. statement from the witness, sarah rogers. her statement stated, “we waved on the lady(amanda) that was injured. the truck going opposite direction didn’t stop and hit her. the impact hit her on the right side and sent her into the air for a brief second before she landed.”i went to speak with the driver of the truck, briggin todd evans dob [date]. briggin stated he just put fuel in the truck at pump 27. briggin stated he was driving normal after leaving the pump. he stated the female walked out in front and she was struck. briggin stated he and the passenger, corey rashad oneal dob [date], are headed to houston. he stated they have been driving all day and stopped for fuel. during this time ems and melissa fire area arriving on scene. i observed the truck a 2015 ford [identifier] super duty. the truck was displaying texas plates of lts-6509. i observed damage to the top of the grill area of the truck. the grill was cracked, and photographs were taken and added to athena.""

records.public_safe_text: see [case id]. unit 1 was southbound [roadway], [roadway]. unit 2 a pedestrian in a wheel chair, [roadway], 57 feet north of the unpainted crosswalk at the intersection of [roadway]. driver 1 stated she was going 30-35 mph, because she knows a lot of people run out into the roadway near this location. driver 1 stated she saw a white flash, in front of her, and slammed on her brakes, but still hit the wheel chair. unit 2, a pedestrian failed to yield right of way to unit 1, rolling out of a private driveway, and into the roadway, in front of unit 1. the pedestrian failed to use a crosswalk provided 57 feet south of the collision area. driver 1 does not possess a drivers license in the state of texas, and has not shown that she has the knowledge to safely operate a motor vehicle on a public roadway of texas. unit 1 collided front concentrated (front left), into the left side of the wheel chair. the pedestrian rolled up onto the front left bumper and hood, then was thrown off the vehicle as unit 1 braked hard, throwing the pedestrian 63 feet, [roadway]. the wheel chair traveled 96 feet south, [roadway]. [medical facility], with a broken right femur, broken pelvis, and broken ribs. pedestrian also had lacerations to her hands that were bleeding, and is the only source of blood that was located at the scene. using the searle minimum and maximum formula for calculating speed for pedestrian throw, the speed for unit 1 was calculated to be between 29 to 35 mph. vehicle crimes unit detectives came to the scene and took digital photos. a 3d leica digital scan was created of the scene. on december 11, 2020 at 0840 am, the pedestrian succumbed to her injuries, [medical facility] by a staff doctor. dallas county medical examiner [case id]. this is traffic fatality # 154 for the dallas police department in 2020. this report is incomplete pending the toxicology results for the pedestrian. ***this report was supplemented to show the toxicology results for unit 2, the pedestrian. results showed positive for ethanol: 0. 029 +/-0. 010 g/100ml, and positive for fentanyl: 2. 2 +/-0. 3 ng/ml. this report is now complete.***

x-1 was parked facing w/b near the fuel pumps by unit-2, the pedestrian. unit-1 was traveling n/b in the same business parking lot from [roadway] with the intent to travel w/b towards the fuel pumps. pumps when he felt a thump and continued w/b and came to a stop at the fuel pumps. unit-1 driver then exited unit-1, looked back and observed unit-2 lying on the ground and called 9-1-1. the parking in the year 2020.
